acquisition_method.evidence: Data acquisition was performed in electrospray ionization positive mode using a data-dependent acquisition method to obtain the corresponding MS/MS spectra.
experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Briefly, the protein solution was entrapped in a polyacrylamide gel matrix before reduction with dithiothreitol and cysteine residue alkylation with iodoacetamide.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Then, proteins were digested with trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI, USA), and peptides were extracted from the gel and purified using a C18 ZipTip (Merck Millipore, Darmstadt, Germany) using the manufacturer’s protocol.
